dedupe_keys.name: consumption based emissions intensity of australia s national electricity market csiro

description: This CSIRO data set gives state-level, consumption-based carbon emissions intensity factors for Australia's National Electricity Market, calculated with a power flow tracing model. It was published by Vahid Aryai and Mark Goldsworthy with a related article in Energy Informatics. Unlike production-based factors, consumption-based factors follow electricity across interconnectors, so they suit calculating Scope 1 and 2 emissions from grid electricity consumed in each state. Coverage is the NEM states. The data are downloadable from the CSIRO Data Access Portal (2022) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the record gives little detail on period and resolution, which are in the article, and factors depend on the flow tracing method. Simulation uses are emissions accounting of power flows and inputs to demand-side and planning studies. Related records: data-egrimod-australia-nem-network describes the NEM network.
